scientific_integrity: Exact all-order elementary proof with independently structured finite verification programs. Counts genuine initially primitive two-cycle states, not all periodic basins. No claim of independent certification or historical first discovery.
scientific_limitations: Full text of the original 1992 Bitar–Goles article unavailable and historical priority not conclusively established; no transient-basin or fixed-state census, and no extension of tree-extremal bounds to general graphs. Finite tests are not a substitute for proof.
title: Sharp Pell extremizers for two-cycle states in parallel chip-firing on trees
